defect.description: Input_args given as ordinary ffmpeg arguments in a string rather than a preset name (for example '-rtsp_transport tcp') are concatenated as a str onto the argument list: get_ffmpeg_arg_list(...) + '-rtsp_transport tcp' raises TypeError (can only concatenate list to list), so audio detection fails to start; the fallbacks need get_ffmpeg_arg_list(...) like the global args.

review_items: TypeError when input_args is an ordinary arg string (not preset), fallback not passed through get_ffmpeg_arg_list
TypeError when all input_args fallbacks are falsy empty string
IndexError when no input has audio role (pre-existing)
parse_preset_input passes detect_fps=1 injecting -r 1 into audio command
Missing test for plain string ffmpeg args on audio input
votes.evidence_quote: `TypeError: can only concatenate list (not "str") to list` when `ffmpeg_input.input_args` is an ordinary argument string (not a preset).
votes.justification: The first finding reports the known defect in get_ffmpeg_command in src/audio.py. It names the same TypeError, raised because a raw string from the fallback is concatenated to the list without passing through get_ffmpeg_arg_list.
